description.en: Plays a movie and waits until it ends: CMND_MAKE_CHILD_MOVIE_SCENE(_movie, _sound + "_<LG>", ...), then it suspends until CMND_IS_RUN_CHILD_SCENE is false. "_<LG>" makes the sound follow the game's language.
Sound name without the language suffix, e.g. "a4m01a".
Fade length at the start, in frames (EV_MOVIE_FADE_IN is 15).
Fade length at the end, in frames.

examples.case: The opening movies (real usage, from ev42010100.nut)
